data.name: Martin
data.gender_notes: Martin is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin Martinus, from Mars, the Roman god of war. Its root is Latin Mars. Saint Martin of Tours. Martin is a Latin name meaning “Of Mars; warlike”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Martin expresses “Of Mars; warlike”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin Martinus, from Mars, the Roman god of war.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Martin total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
